purpose: Finite-grid sensitivity analysis, not a calibrated probability or safety envelope
baseline_source: terrain.py Model; default mission in frontend/src/main.tsx

speed_m_s.label: [ASSUMPTION]
speed_m_s.basis: Design stress test: 80%,100%,120% of the declared0.5m/s baseline; no physiological calibration

slope_penalty_multiplier.label: [ASSUMPTION]
slope_penalty_multiplier.basis: Scale the existing uphill4 and downhill2 together; not independent axes and not published fits

slope_gate_deg.label: [ASSUMPTION]
slope_gate_deg.basis: Apply the same gate to surface slope and directional grade; two stricter cases and the existing20degree baseline, not astronaut limits

station_dwell_min.label: [ASSUMPTION]
station_dwell_min.basis: Apply to each of the two planned stops;15min is the existing scenario input,10/20 are proposed design perturbations

reserve_min.label: [ASSUMPTION]
reserve_min.basis: Proposed reserve-policy scenarios around the existing72min setting; not certified emergency reserves

combination_policy: Full Cartesian product:243 combinations;27 terrain graphs,9 dwell/reserve combinations per graph. No averaging of colors. No outcome generated before approval.
interpretation: Green in every tested combination means robustness only within this finite declared grid, not all continuous parameter values or human safety. Green in some combinations means assumption-sensitive. Never evaluated or blocked is not relabeled safe.
